ns2:course.label: Mechanical Design, II
ns2:course.description: (M E 272) Design and analysis of machinery for loadbearing and power transmission. Consideration of material failure modes, including yielding, fracture, fatigue and creep. Design and selection of machine elements: bolts, springs, rolling element bearings, fluid film lubrication, and power transmissions, including gears and friction drives. Prerequisite: ME 330 and ME 370
